notes: Real Earth data only. Nothing in this file is simulated or invented.
Each series has the agreed contract fields (regionId, variable, unit, source.agency/dataset/version, observations[{date, value}]) plus provenance.
date is 'YYYY-MM'. Months run without gaps from temporal.start to temporal.end; value is null where data are missing. Never fill nulls with zero.

kind tells you what a series is: 'reanalysis' = NASA model output that assimilates observations (MERRA-2); 'satellite' = satellite estimates (GPM IMERG, merged with rain gauges); 'station' = ground measurements from one weather station.
Series can cover different periods (IMERG starts in 1998). Read temporal.start and temporal.end for each one.
Correlation between series does not show that one causes the other.

series.label: Precipitation (rain and snow)
series.kindNote: Model reanalysis that assimilates observations. Not a direct measurement.
series.definition: Bias-corrected total precipitation reaching the surface, including the water in snow.

source.dataset: MERRA-2 via NASA POWER Monthly and Annual API
citation: NASA Langley Research Center (LaRC) POWER Project, Monthly and Annual API (https://power.larc.nasa.gov). Acknowledgement guidance: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/acknowledgements/
Gelaro, R., et al. (2017). The Modern-Era Retrospective Analysis for Research and Applications, Version 2 (MERRA-2). Journal of Climate, 30, 5419-5454. https://doi.org/10.1175/JCLI-D-16-0758.1
source.license: NASA Earth science data: open, no restrictions on use (NASA Earthdata data use guidance). Acknowledge NASA POWER and cite MERRA-2.

processing: Area-weighted mean of 15 MERRA-2 grid cells inside the region box, weighted by cos(latitude).
A month is kept only if cells holding at least half the total weight have data; otherwise null.
POWER's month '13' (annual value) is dropped.
Converted from mm/day (monthly mean daily rate) to mm/month by multiplying by the number of days in that month.
caveats: Each value averages over roughly 50 km grid cells, so it is smoother than any single place and cooler than the Phoenix urban core.
Reanalysis can shift when the observing system changes; check large jumps against the station record.

series.label: Precipitation (satellite, GPM IMERG)
series.kindNote: Satellite precipitation estimates merged with and calibrated against rain gauges.
series.definition: IMERG Final Run merged satellite-gauge precipitation estimate, the variable GES DISC recommends for general use. Microwave and infrared satellite estimates, calibrated with monthly rain-gauge analyses.

source.dataset: GPM IMERG Final Run, monthly (GPM_3IMERGM), via NASA Giovanni
source.access: Earthdata Login with the 'NASA GESDISC DATA ARCHIVE' application approved
citation: Huffman, G. J., Stocker, E. F., Bolvin, D. T., Nelkin, E. J., & Tan, J. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07 [Dataset]. NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07
Analyses and visualizations used in this product were produced with the Giovanni online data system, developed and maintained by the NASA GES DISC.
source.license: NASA data: open, no restrictions on use (NASA Earthdata data use guidance). GPM is a joint NASA-JAXA mission; cite the dataset DOI.

spatial.method: Giovanni area average over the 0.1° cells inside the box (Giovanni excludes fill values).

processing: Area average computed by Giovanni; CSV saved unchanged (checksum pinned in scripts/process_data.py).
Converted from mm/hr (monthly mean rate) to mm/month by multiplying by 24 x the number of days in that month.
caveats: Starts in 1998, 17 years after the MERRA-2 and station records, so its trends cover a different period.
Satellite rain estimates are least reliable for light rain and over complex terrain such as the mountains in the box.

series.label: Precipitation (station gauge)
series.kindNote: Ground measurements from one weather station.
series.definition: Total precipitation measured at the station in the month. NCEI sets the month to missing if more than 5 days are missing or flagged.

citation: Lawrimore, J. H., Ray, R., Applequist, S., Korzeniewski, B., Menne, M. J. (2016). Global Summary of the Month (GSOM), Version 1. NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. Station USW00023183.
source.license: Free of charge from NCEI. No explicit licence or redistribution terms found; cite as above.

processing: Values as published by NCEI with units=metric; no unit conversion.
Months NCEI left blank are null. daysMissing (1-5) is copied from the GSOM attribute field when present.
caveats: A single airport station in a large city. Its trend mixes regional climate with urban growth (urban heat island) and any instrument or siting changes.
A point measurement: do not compare its values directly with the area-mean reanalysis without saying so.

series.definition: (Mean of daily maximum + mean of daily minimum) / 2. Missing if more than 5 days, or more than 3 days in a row, are missing.
